**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Drain deferred errors before accepting turn completion**

When the App Server emits an agent message and successful `turn/completed`, followed by a same-turn `error`, all before the `turn/start` response, this branch queues both terminal events. The main loop later consumes the completion first and exits without examining the queued error, so the review can become `gate_ready` despite the explicit error notification. Inspect all deferred errors for the resolved turn before accepting its completion.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
